questions.question: What measures ad clicks per impression?
questions.explanation: CTR tracks click-through rate effectiveness.

questions.question: What advertising model charges per click?
questions.explanation: PPC charges advertisers per click received.

questions.question: What creates valuable content to attract audiences?
questions.explanation: Content marketing provides value to audiences.

questions.question: What metric tracks return on investment?
questions.explanation: ROI measures marketing profitability.

questions.question: What marketing uses search engines?
questions.explanation: SEM promotes websites through search engines.

questions.question: What re-engages previous website visitors?
questions.explanation: Retargeting shows ads to past visitors.

questions.question: What divides customers into groups?
questions.explanation: Segmentation groups similar customers together.

questions.question: What social platform is most professional?
questions.explanation: LinkedIn focuses on professional networking.

questions.question: What tests two versions to find the best?
questions.explanation: A/B testing compares two variations.

questions.question: What percentage of visitors complete goals?
questions.explanation: Conversion rate measures goal completions.

questions.question: What advertising shows visual banner ads across partner websites?
questions.explanation: Display ads appear as banners on publisher sites.

questions.question: What model pays partners commission for referred sales?
questions.explanation: Affiliates earn commissions on attributed sales.

questions.question: What practice has users voluntarily subscribe to marketing messages?
questions.explanation: Opt-in ensures consent-based marketing lists.

questions.question: What dedicated page is designed to convert visitors from a specific campaign?
questions.explanation: Landing pages focus visitors on one campaign goal.

questions.question: What button text prompts immediate user action like "Buy Now"?
questions.explanation: CTAs direct users toward conversion actions.

questions.question: Which funnel stage is first, when customers discover a brand?
questions.explanation: Awareness introduces the brand to new audiences.

questions.question: What targeting selects audiences by age, gender, or income?
questions.explanation: Demographic targeting uses population attributes.

questions.question: What strategy delivers a seamless experience across all sales channels?
questions.explanation: Omnichannel unifies customer experience everywhere.

questions.question: What is customer-created content like reviews and photos called?
questions.explanation: UGC builds trust through authentic customer voices.

questions.question: A campaign sent 10,000 emails and 2,500 were opened. What is the open rate?
questions.explanation: 2,500 divided by 10,000 equals 25%.

questions.question: A landing page had 1,000 visits and 50 purchases. What is the conversion rate?
questions.explanation: 50 divided by 1,000 equals 5%.

questions.question: What Google Ads extension adds extra links beneath the main ad?
questions.explanation: Sitelinks add navigational links to search ads.

questions.question: Which Google Ads bidding strategy sets bids to hit a target cost per acquisition?
questions.explanation: Target CPA optimizes bids for conversion costs.

questions.question: What metric counts the unique users who saw a piece of content?
questions.explanation: Reach measures unique viewers; impressions count all views.

questions.question: An ad received 200 clicks from 10,000 impressions. What is the CTR?
questions.explanation: 200 divided by 10,000 equals 2%.

questions.question: What targeting finds new users who resemble existing customers?
questions.explanation: Lookalikes match traits of current customers.

questions.question: An analyst wants every marketing touchpoint in a conversion path to receive equal credit. Which attribution model does this?
questions.explanation: Linear attribution distributes credit equally across all touchpoints; position-based weights first and last.

questions.question: Variant B shows a 12% conversion lift over control in an A/B test, but the p-value is 0.12. What should the analyst conclude?
options: B is the statistically significant winner
the result is not statistically significant at the 95% level
questions.explanation: p = 0.12 exceeds the 0.05 threshold, so the lift may be due to chance; significance is unproven.

questions.question: A campaign spends 20,000 pesos on ads and returns 100,000 pesos in revenue. What is the ROAS?
questions.explanation: ROAS = 100,000 / 20,000 = 5, expressed as 5:1.

questions.question: A store spent 90,000 pesos on ads and sales staff to win 300 new customers. What is the CAC?
questions.explanation: CAC = total acquisition spend / new customers = 90,000 / 300 = 300 pesos.

questions.question: Visitors who viewed products but did not buy now see those exact products in ads on other websites. Which tactic is this?
questions.explanation: Retargeting serves ads to past visitors based on their browsing, typically via cookies or pixels.
